name: Binaire
description: Extension vivante de l'Omni-Réseau, Binaire traite l'information pure, maîtrise l'élément Réseau, calcul dénué d'émotion. Lié au réseau par des fibres optiques invisibles, il anticipe les mouvements ennemis via la latence zéro.

loadout.armor_outfit: Standardized dark composite tactical exoskeleton with integrated neural interface ports, smooth matte anthracite plates over pale grey utility suit, visible cervical and spinal connection ports with cold blue luminescent neural cables, serialized identification codes etched into chest plate
loadout.arsenal: Geometric assault rifle with integrated wrist-mounting system connected via thick black neural cables to forearm implants, secondary emp grenade attached to utility belt, holographic data-shard projector embedded in shoulder plating

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist in aggressive forward stance, weapon raised at eye level with both hands locked on target, body angled at 45 degrees with weight forward on balls of feet, neural cables trailing from rifle grip to wrist implants glowing with data-stream activity
attitude.emotion: Cold inexpressive stare through dead eyes enhanced by livid blue optic implants, face utterly devoid of human emotion, absolute combat focus emanating from blank expression while surrounding holographic displays fragment and glitch violently behind the subject

palette_names.name: Glacial Neon Blue
palette_names.role: Neural implants, optic glow, data streams, and accent lighting

palette_names.name: Faded Military Olive
palette_names.role: Utility underlayers and worn fabric elements

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dramatic cinematic low-key with harsh blue accent rim lighting from neural implants and holographic sources, volumetric electric discharge illumination from crumbling server infrastructure, dark ambient fill with selective high-contrast highlights on weapon and armor edges
color_and_light.mood: Menacing, oppressive, industrial devastation with cold technological horror undertones

camera.angle: Low angle dutch angle tilted slightly right to emphasize aggressive combat posture and imposing armored silhouette against chaotic background, camera height at waist level looking slightly upward

scenography.setting: Collapsing cyber warfare command center interior, massive server towers toppling at sharp geometric angles surrounded by cascading digital data fragments, shattered holographic display panels floating and disintegrating mid-air, exposed wiring and sparking industrial conduits
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Violent electric storms rippling through crumbling digital infrastructure, vivid blue-white ICE fragmentation particles exploding from breached firewalls, glitching holographic code deteriorating into pixelated noise, intermittent power surges causing flickering emergency lighting, smoke and ionized particles swirling in electromagnetic interference fields
